newsitem.title: USA: Huntsman offers $16 cash/share for Rexene.
newsitem.headline: Huntsman offers $16 cash/share for Rexene.

text.p: Privately held Huntsman Corp said Thursday it was making a "final offer" of $16 cash per share for chemicals company Rexene Corp.
"Our offer will not be open indefinitely and is, in fact our final offer," J. Kimo Esplin, Huntsman chief financial officer, said in a statement.
He said the company could complete a due diligence review within two weeks and had requested that Rexene not undertake a proposed issue of preference shares.
Huntsman said it hoped to end months of argument and counter-argument over whether it could finance a takeover.
"To unfairly cast doubt on our ability to finance this acquisition is to once again create unnecessary roadblocks standing in the way of shareholder value," Esplin said.

Huntsman said it had completed several sizable acquisitions and was sending to Rexene Chief Executive Andrew Smith letters from BT Securities, Chase Securities and Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette testifying to its ability to finance the deal.
Since Huntsman first approached Rexene last summer, Rexene's board has challenged the suitor's ability to finance a takeover.
Rexene shares rallied on news of the $16-a-share offer, rising 1/2 to 14-3/8 in afternoon trading.
The offer values Rexene at around $300 million, and Huntsman would also assume $250 million of Rexene debt.
A spokesman for Rexene said the offer had not yet been evaluated and the company had no comment.
In its last letter to Huntsman, Rexene called on the company to prove it had financing for a deal and to sign a confidentiality agreement.
A spokesman for Huntsman declined comment on financing and on whether the company would have to raise funds to finance its takeover offer.
Huntsman is the largest privately held chemical company in the U.S.

Huntsman said in its statement today that assuming the due diligence review of Rexene was satisfactory, "we would be in a position to execute a merger agreement that is not subject to financing or additional due diligence."
Huntsman said it has made several offers to buy Rexene since last July.
